```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

Mplus Version 9 extends dynamic structural equation modeling to three-level
hierarchies (`TYPE = THREELEVEL RANDOM`, or DSEM3; Asparouhov & Muthen, 2026)
such as momentary assessments nested within days/bursts (Level 2) nested within
individuals or clinics (Level 3), alongside subject-by-time cross-classified
DSEM (`TYPE = CROSSCLASSIFIED RANDOM`).

## Three-level DSEM (`DSEM3`)

In `DSEMr`, three-level hierarchies are declared with `id = c("level2", "level3")`
in `lavaan` syntax or `VARIABLE: CLUSTER = level3 level2; ANALYSIS: TYPE = THREELEVEL RANDOM;`
in Mplus syntax. Latent variable decomposition separates Level-1, Level-2, and
Level-3 variance components automatically.

```{r}
library(DSEMr)

dat_3l <- simulate_dsem(
  n = 15, clusters = c(8, 3), id = c("day", "person"),
  intercept = 1.0, ar = 0.45, sigma = 0.7,
  random_sd = c(0.35, 0.08, 0.15), seed = 901
)

m_3l <- dsem_model("
  VARIABLE: CLUSTER = person day;
  ANALYSIS: TYPE = THREELEVEL RANDOM; ESTIMATOR = BAYES;
  MODEL:
    %WITHIN%
      s | y ON y&1;
      logv | y;
    %BETWEEN day%
      y;
    %BETWEEN person%
      y s logv WITH y s logv;
", syntax = "mplus", time = "time")

fit_3l <- dsem(m_3l, dat_3l, chains = 2, iter = 300, warmup = 150, seed = 902)
coef(fit_3l)
dsem_dic(fit_3l)
```

## Cross-classified DSEM

Cross-classified DSEM accounts simultaneously for subject-level random dynamics
and occasion-specific common shocks across all individuals:

```{r}
dat_cc <- simulate_dsem(
  n = 16, clusters = 10, intercept = 0.5, ar = 0.40, sigma = 0.6,
  cross_classified = TRUE, time_sd = 0.30, seed = 940
)

m_cc <- dsem_model("
  VARIABLE: CLUSTER = time id;
  ANALYSIS: TYPE = CROSSCLASSIFIED RANDOM; ESTIMATOR = BAYES;
  MODEL:
    %WITHIN%
      s | y ON y&1;
    %BETWEEN id%
      y s;
    %BETWEEN time%
      y;
", syntax = "mplus", time = "time")

fit_cc <- dsem(m_cc, dat_cc, chains = 2, iter = 300, warmup = 150, seed = 941)
coef(fit_cc)
```
